code_stages.buffers: Initial stage: bounded half packing/headroom/readback/HEIF planes implemented; before metrics fusion and production quantize slicing. Fixed-array buffer ablation, not complete render timing.
code_stages.optional: Final row-wise B3 implementation and bounded CFA guidance, ABI18; excludes the superseded slower initial B3 implementation. Before delivery metric workspace integration. Handles/gated/deep-fusion probes remain independent experiments.
code_stages.metrics: Final numerical metric kernels, ABI18 release: fused base+coding and multi-rank HDR workspace. Standalone direct calls measured before production dispatcher wiring and last alignment/ambient-buffer validation additions; ordinary aligned input and matching NumPy buffer used. Not an end-to-end codec time.
code_stages.quantize: Existing ABI18 output kernel measured before enabling production slice routing. Complete A then B noise and output identity pinned; neither process changes a production dispatcher.
code_stages.final_validation: Final production routes, alignment adapters, RGBA gate, explicit group-noise release, PreparedSceneSample and GUI/IO changes require the separate full-pipeline completion record. The timings here must not be called final complete-pipeline benchmarks.
code_stages.prepared_master: Added after these standalone measurements: one immutable base/HDR snapshot, banded finite/peak checks, CI owner/context reuse, separate auto scheduler/manual candidate with nonrecursive auxiliary retry. These microbenchmarks do not measure its extra HDR snapshot or final codec search; use the final complete-pipeline validation record.

notes: Three repetitions per comparison; see source records for cold calls and environment.
Full input/output identities retained. Verbose optional cProfile tables and quantize process sample traces omitted; original source SHA256 retained.
Buffer/metrics RSS is process high-water MiB; quantize external RSS is sampled bytes and may miss transient peaks.
HDR workspace retention is capacity between candidates, not an upper bound on active-call memory.
